in_english.long_meaning: The name Rafaellino has Hebrew roots, derived from the name Raphael, which means God heals, messenger of God, bringer of good news, healer, protector, servant of God. In Christian tradition, Raphael is the seventh archangel, associated with healing, protection, and good news. The name Rafaellino is a diminutive form of Raphael, commonly used in Italian culture. It symbolizes spiritual guidance, protection, and healing, making it a popular choice for parents seeking a name with strong biblical roots.
